title: Maximum Increasing Triplet Value
description:
Given an array nums , return the maximum value of a triplet (i, j, k) such that i < j < k and nums[i] < nums[j] < nums[k] . 
 
 The value of a triplet (i, j, k) is nums[i] - nums[j] + nums[k] . 

 Example 1: 

 Input: nums = [5,6,9] 
 
 Output: 8 
 
 Explanation: We only have one choice for an increasing triplet and that is choosing all three elements. The value of this triplet would be 5 - 6 + 9 = 8 . 

 Example 2: 

 Input: nums = [1,5,3,6] 
 
 Output: 4 
 
 Explanation: There are only two increasing triplets: 
 
 (0, 1, 3) : The value of this triplet is nums[0] - nums[1] + nums[3] = 1 - 5 + 6 = 2 . 
 
 (0, 2, 3) : The value of this triplet is nums[0] - nums[2] + nums[3] = 1 - 3 + 6 = 4 . 
 
 Thus the answer would be 4 . 

 Constraints: 

 3 <= nums.length <= 10 5 
 
 1 <= nums[i] <= 10 9 
 
 The input is generated such that at least one triplet meets the given condition.
code: class Solution {struct BIT{vector<long long> t;BIT(int n):t(n+1,LLONG_MIN/4){}void add(int i,long long v){for(;i<(int)t.size();i+=i&-i)t[i]=max(t[i],v);}long long get(int i){long long v=LLONG_MIN/4;for(;i;i-=i&-i)v=max(v,t[i]);return v;}};public:int maximumTripletValue(vector<int>& a){vector<int> v=a;sort(v.begin(),v.end());v.erase(unique(v.begin(),v.end()),v.end());BIT b(v.size()),c(v.size());long long ans=LLONG_MIN/4;for(int x:a){int i=lower_bound(v.begin(),v.end(),x)-v.begin()+1;ans=max(ans,c.get(i-1)+x);c.add(i,b.get(i-1)-x);b.add(i,x);}return (int)ans;}};
